agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes or sensor noise; initial cart offset x=0.44 m and velocity v=0.31 m/s with pole upright. The state-feedback controller prioritizes pole regulation (theta ~0.08 rad, margin 0.71 rad) over cart position, applying a small persistent positive force (~0.8-0.87 N) in the drift direction to keep the pole balanced rather than braking the cart. Cart velocity grows monotonically from 0.30 to 1.37 m/s over 261 steps, position drifts from 0.43 m to 2.40 m, exceeding the 2.4 m track at step 261. Reducing only initial x from 0.436 to 0.0 removes the position bias and the scenario runs clean, confirming the drift/bias cause.
